COMMENTS: At Niche Batu Sindu sites 1 to 4, seven adzes were found on the surface, among granite blocks within the Niche Batu Sindu complex. Made of hard, fine-grained clay, these adzes were found scattered among pottery shards. Some were intact. Only a portion of these adzes were completed, as the rest were still in the process of being made, often referred to as "candidate adzes." However, on this site too found this type of pottery with a decoration called a stamped face or engraved (paddle mark) on fruit patterns known as patterns Malay smells, lots of them found at sites in Asia Southeast Mainland, even in Malaysian Borneo like in a cave Sireh with enough dates about 5000 years ago.
